excerpt.zh: 矩阵乘法指数论文标题声称复杂度达到 Θ(n^2.25)。现有来源只提供论文链接和讨论热度，未展示证明细节或独立验证。

text.zh: 一篇关于矩阵乘法指数的新预印本引发关注：Hacker News 上的投稿标题称，矩阵乘法可达到 Θ(n^2.25) 的渐近复杂度。链接指向 OpenAI 的 math 仓库中的 PDF，文件路径也将该结果表述为指数九分之四，即 2.25。
text.en: A new preprint on the matrix multiplication exponent has drawn attention: its Hacker News submission title says matrix multiplication can reach an asymptotic complexity of Θ(n^2.25). The link points to a PDF in OpenAI’s math repository, whose file path also describes the exponent as nine-fourths, or 2.25.

text.zh: 矩阵乘法指数声称什么
text.en: What the matrix multiplication exponent claim says

text.zh: 这里的指数描述的是矩阵规模增长时，算法运算量如何按幂次增长；指数越低，理论上的大规模计算成本增长越慢。Θ(n^2.25) 因而是一个关于渐近复杂度的主张，不等于对所有实际矩阵、硬件或规模都能更快的保证。
text.en: The exponent describes how an algorithm’s operation count grows as matrix dimensions increase; a lower exponent means slower theoretical growth in cost at large sizes. Thus Θ(n^2.25) is an asymptotic complexity claim, not a guarantee of faster performance for every practical matrix, machine, or problem size.

text.zh: 这类结果若经严格证明并得到同行检验，可能推进人们对矩阵乘法理论边界的认识。不过，给出的来源摘录只是 GitHub 页面内容，没有论文摘要、证明、实验或审稿信息。现阶段不能据此判断论证采用了什么方法、适用条件是什么，也不能确认结果已获独立验证。
text.en: If rigorously proved and examined by other researchers, a result of this kind could advance understanding of the theoretical limits of matrix multiplication. However, the supplied excerpt contains only GitHub page content, not the paper’s abstract, proof, experiments, or review status. It therefore does not establish the method, conditions under which the claim holds, or whether the result has been independently checked.
